lessonTitle: 5. The function y = a(x − x₀)² + y₀
lessonTitleEnglish: The function y = a(x − x₀)² + y₀
unit: Algebra · Chapter 1. Properties of numerical functions
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: The graph of y = a(x − x₀)² + y₀ is y = ax² shifted x₀ along Ox and y₀ along Oy; its vertex is (x₀; y₀).
stages.headlineEnglish: The graph of y = a(x − x₀)² + y₀ is y = ax² shifted x₀ along Ox and y₀ along Oy; its vertex is (x₀; y₀).

stages.headline: The line x = x₀ through the vertex is the parabola's axis of symmetry.
stages.headlineEnglish: The line x = x₀ through the vertex is the parabola's axis of symmetry.

stages.headline: For a > 0 the least value is y₀; for a < 0 the greatest is y₀.
stages.headlineEnglish: For a > 0 the least value is y₀; for a < 0 the greatest is y₀.
